general_filtered_complex_theorem.proof: z+D b lies in F iff pi(z)=-pi(D b), exactly vanishing of the quotient class.
general_filtered_complex_theorem.statement: For any complex K with a declared degree-n filtration subspace F and projection pi:K^n->K^n/F, a cocycle z is cohomologous to an element of F iff [pi(z)]=0 in pi(Z^n)/pi(B^n).
